channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rasual Butler | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rasual Butler from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Rasual Butler
item.description:
Pop on Rasual Butler:

“He was a wonderful teammate for everybody. He was a good person in every way. He was always upbeat, always ready to do whatever we asked. Just a wonderful guy.”

Gregg Popovich on Rasual Butler, Feb 1, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Rasual Butler
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Dwane Casey on the passing of Rasual Butler, who he coached with the Raptors in 2011-12:

“I just saw him this summer in LA. We talked at length about him getting into coaching. He was a veteran leader for us. That is why he stayed in the league so long. He left us way too soon.”

Dwane Casey on Rasual Butler, Jan 31, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Rasual Butler
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Casey:

“Rasual was one of the original members of our program when I started here. His work ethic and enthusiasm for the game were the mark of a true professional. He was a pleasure to coach and will be missed...we want to offer our sincerest condolences to the families involved”

Dwane Casey on Rasual Butler, Jan 31, 2018. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Rasual Butler
item.description:
Tom Osborn:Pop on keeping Butler:

“He brought me cupcakes every other day, smiled @ me, treated me really well, made me feel good about myself.”

Gregg Popovich on Rasual Butler, Oct 26, 2015. Source: Twitter.
